overview: The Geomantic Crater is the epicenter of Mons Letalis’s instability.
details: Ancient lunar upheavals ruptured the geomantic lattice, creating gravity wells and pulse storms that still destabilize the region.
hooks: A gravity well expands toward the crater rim.
Pulse storms intensify, destabilizing stone shelves.
Rockhoppers burrow into newly exposed caverns.
A levitation vortex reveals a hidden chamber.
